rules.visual_cue: Cash or an open cash drawer is left on the desk while the cashier walks away or turns away from the workstation.
rules.not_a_violation: Cashier briefly reaches for something within arm's length; cash is locked or covered.

rules.visual_cue: A person who is not the cashier enters the cashier's side of the desk or touches cash there.
rules.not_a_violation: A customer stays on the customer side of the window; cash collectors in a handover.

rules.type_ru: Иное нарушение порядка работы с наличными
rules.visual_cue: Any other clearly visible handling of cash, valuables, or the workstation that departs from careful cash procedure.
rules.not_a_violation: Normal counting, serving a customer, typing, routine movement.
